scope: 77 LOCAL runtime form keys retained;63 ordinary XML catalog entries active. Recheck promoted0:7 policy-backed special labels lack item-specific duration;15 other labels lack attributed equipment/identity policy. SPR static name matches78/85. namespaces.classic_item_template: native-dump item ID; grade is separate (0 blessed, 1 normal, 2 cursed; game_data.py DropDef).
namespaces.classic_sprite: current-parsed sprite_id/# key, not resource file_id or native NPC template ID.
namespaces.native_npc: native-dump NPC id is a template, f2 a sprite identity candidate; ordinary creature and morph SPR can differ.
namespaces.l1j_polymorph_id: polymorphs.id is reference-table identity; polyid is the L1J visual key. Neither automatically equals a Classic SPR key.
namespaces.character_class: UI/backend class IDs never supply base appearance; caller captures actual original SPR.

static_facts.note: Native dump provides item/NPC identity, not a list of polymorph choices; SPR names provide separate Classic visual evidence.

backend_policy_sources.note: L1J levels, equipment/skill/cause masks and duration are reference-backed LOCAL backend policies, not Classic official server rules.

weapon_kind_aliases.axe: explicit local alias of blunt bit8
weapon_kind_aliases.blunt: L1J type6 bit8, not a sword
weapon_kind_aliases.unarmed: no equipped weapon; permitted even for mask0

policy_limits: Masks are bitsets, not a boolean may_equip_weapon: 256 allows bow family only, 751 allows dagger/sword/twohand/blunt/staff/edoryu/claw/kiringku and excludes spear/bow/chainsword.
Unknown weapon kinds return unknown and refuse a proposal locally; old L1J fallback true is not copied as Classic permission.
Incompatible weapon requests takeoff. Armor takeoff and skill restrictions are not applied by this pure module. No equipment is automatically restored.
Timer is replaced rather than extended. Normal1800s and blessed2100s are L1J policy. Inclusive millisecond deadline is local scheduling policy.

GM/event bypass, map5124, awake/quest forms6034/6035, ring-specific selection, ALT_POLYEVENT, new generation rules and special items are outside this module. Caller owns its life/map/equipment restrictions.

Normal scroll grade1 is an explicit backend mapping to Classic299. Blessed grade0 reuses that template with separate grade, a LOCAL variant policy; native dump does not prove blessed availability. Cursed grade2 is unsupported.
Base appearance comes from actual caller state. No automatic class/gender lookup or L1J classId restore is assumed.
